title: arequipa rettigii
intro: Arequipa rettigii, commonly known as the  Arequipa tree, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest.  It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its health benefits such as reducing pain and inflammation, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Arequipa rettigii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
